name: Linky online
description: The whole house's daily use from Enedis, whoever your supplier is, no hardware.
author: LocalAssistant

device.title: Linky (Enedis online)
device.description: No hardware: Enedis's daily use, a day behind, through conso.boris.sh. Sign in there with your Enedis account (Enedis holds every Linky's readings, whoever your supplier is), allow it, and copy the token. For live power, use a ZLinky_TIC Zigbee reader instead.

fields.name: prm
fields.label: PRM
fields.description: On your bill, or on the meter: press + until it shows the PRM.
fields.message: Type the 14-digit PRM from your bill or the meter.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Token
fields.description: Stored encrypted, never shown again. A new one comes from conso.boris.sh.
fields.message: Paste the token conso.boris.sh gave you.
